steps.note: a first open, whatever an earlier run left on disk
the boot read tourSeen; a tour would have opened by now
two blocks on screen and one hidden, so the sheet has something to explain
steps.expression: (async () => { const id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.split('/')[2]); const base = { kind: 'text', depth: 0, mediaPath: '', mediaName: '', size: 'medium', fontPx: 30, revealStep: null, collapsed: false }; const blocks = [{ ...base, key: 'k0', content: [{ text: 'Abertura' }], plannedVisible: true, takeVisible: true }, { ...base, key: 'k1', content: [{ text: 'Gancho' }], plannedVisible: true, takeVisible: true }, { ...base, key: 'k2', content: [{ text: 'Pergunta ao chat' }], plannedVisible: false, takeVisible: false }]; const response = await fetch('/api/rundowns/' + id + '/sheet', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ blocks }) }); return response.status; })()

steps.note: 'Já vi o tour' is on disk
the Play catalog lists only the sheet, rundown, media and preference routes
steps.expression: (async () => { const catalog = await (await fetch('/api/aioson-play')).json(); const paths = catalog.endpoints.map((e) => e.method + ' ' + e.path); const retired = paths.filter((p) => /\/api\/(runs|library|blocks|beats|open-url)|preflight|open-run|report|track\/reorder/.test(p) || p === 'GET /api/rundowns/:id'); return retired.length === 0 && paths.length === 15; })()

steps.note: no resource came from another host: fonts and media are the app's own
steps.expression: (() => { const entries = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').map((e) => e.name); const fonts = entries.filter((n) => n.endsWith('.woff2')).map((n) => new URL(n).pathname).sort(); return entries.every((n) => new URL(n).host === location.host) && fonts.join(',') === '/fonts/inter-variable.woff2,/fonts/jetbrains-mono-variable.woff2'; })()
